q: Do brass parts exported from Jamnagar fall under EU CBAM?
title: Jamnagar brass parts and CBAM
short: No. Brass is a copper alloy, and CBAM covers iron and steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, hydrogen and electricity. Copper and brass goods are not on the Annex I list, though steel screws or aluminium parts in the same shipment may be.
audience: Brass component makers in the Jamnagar cluster of Gujarat exporting to Europe

p: Brass fittings and turned parts: outside CBAM.
Steel fasteners or aluminium components shipped with them: check their CN codes against Annex I.
A product carbon footprint for their Scope 3, where the brass rod you buy is a major line. Keep the rod supplier's figure if they give one.
